correctness.rationale: Independent random orders give probability 1/(n)_s for each compatible set of s prescribed distinct arcs of one colour. Disjoint signed overlap motifs determine all leading joint factorial moments; any overlapping motif cluster has more coloured arcs than free vertices, yielding o(1). Hence every mixed falling-factorial moment tends to one and the joint law is independent unit Poisson. Endpoint collisions, motif-to-motif contacts, and endpoint-to-motif contacts vanish in probability. On the clean event each vertex row-mask support is generic, a single endpoint deletion, or a two-sign collision merging; signed collision-presence bits uniquely determine the family of realized local signature supports. A two-round EF strategy proves equality of these supports is precisely rank-two elementary equivalence, and explicit rank-two formulas separate bits. The limitations about fixed r, quantifier depth, and finite calculations are explicit.

value.rationale: The first nontrivial quantifier depth in a vocabulary with independent immediate successors is the depth at which two different orderings can be jointly observed. The theorem computes every positive-probability complete rank-two theory and its exact nonzero mass for arbitrary fixed numbers of orders, rather than merely verifying one formula or a routine numerical parameter. It supplies a motivated, complete logical limit-type classification with interpretable Poisson collision origins and explicit probabilities.
